subject: POC: Performance & ROI snapshot — request for short quote and 15m call
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ethan Sykes <ethan.sykes@acmetoys.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC: Performance & ROI snapshot — request for short quote and 15m call

Hi Ethan —

Thanks again for running the POC with us — really appreciated the close collaboration from your team. I wanted to pull together a very short summary of the outcomes and ask for a small favor (two-line quote or a quick 15-minute call) we can use in a case brief. TL;DR below; full spreadsheet attached.

Key outcomes (30-day POC running Redwood Inference hosted endpoint):
- Median inference latency: 85ms (down from ~270ms) — ~3.2x improvement
- Average tokens per request: ~120; overall token cost per inference reduced ~42% vs your prior baseline
- Throughput: sustained 220 reqs/min during peak testing (warm KV caching enabled)
- Quality: 95% pass rate on the automated prompt suite we ran (low false positives on classification checks)
- Estimated monthly run-rate savings (model + infra): ~$6.5k for your current volume; projected to scale linearly with usage

Attachment: [Attachment: acme-poc-metrics.xlsx (xlsx)] — includes per-test breakdown, percentile latencies, and cost model assumptions.

Would you be comfortable either: (A) a 1-2 sentence quote we can publish (we’ll attribute to Acme Toys), or (B) a quick 15-minute call so we can capture a short audio quote and confirm attribution? If A works, a couple of examples below you can copy/edit. If B, here are a few proposed times (PDT): Tue May 12 10:00–10:15, Tue May 12 15:00–15:15, Wed May 13 09:00–09:15 — I can send a calendar invite.

Example quote options (feel free to edit):
1) “Redwood’s inference platform cut latency ~3x and reduced our per-inference cost materially — it made our recommendation service viable in production.”
2) “We saw a fast, predictable improvement in latency and cost; Redwood’s runtime gave us the performance we needed without heavy ops overhead.”

If it helps, we’ll send a one-paragraph case brief and the short quote back for your sign-off before anything is published.

Thanks — speak soon.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0124

Lauren —

Appreciate the clear summary and the spreadsheet — nice work by your team. The numbers look right vs what we measured internally. We’re happy to provide a short quote. Option 1 is closest to what I’d say; I edited it slightly below. I can also do a 15-minute call if you need audio, Wed May 13 at 09:00 PDT works for me.

Proposed quote (ok to attribute to Acme Toys):
“Redwood’s inference platform reduced our median latency by ~3x and delivered meaningful cost savings, which made deploying our new recommender feasible at scale.”

Confirming: you have permission to use the quoted line and the metrics in the attached spreadsheet for a public case brief. We’ll loop in Legal if you need a signature, otherwise this email is fine for now.

Thanks,
Ethan
Product Lead — Recommendations
Acme Toys
ethan.sykes@acmetoys.com
(212) 555-0199
